ei.title: Digital Permanence: How Online Messages Never Fade

fullPassage: Content shared through social media often sticks around because technologies are designed to enable persistence. The fact that content often persists has significant implications. Such content enables interactions to take place over time in an asynchronous fashion. Alice may write to Bob at midnight while Bob is sound asleep; but when Bob wakes up in the morning or comes back from summer camp three weeks later, that message will still be there waiting for him, even if Alice had forgotten about it. Persistence means that conversations conducted through social media are far from ephemeral; they endure. Persistence enables different kinds of interactions than the ephemerality of a park. Alice's message doesn't expire when Bob reads it, and Bob can keep that message for decades. What persistence also means, then, is that those using social media are often "on the record" to an unprecedented degree.

questions.passage: Content shared through social media often (A)[sticks around / disappears] because technologies are designed to enable persistence. The fact that content often persists has (B)[significant / trivial] implications. Such content enables interactions to take place over time in an asynchronous fashion. Alice may write to Bob at midnight while Bob is sound asleep; but when Bob wakes up in the morning or comes back from summer camp three weeks later, that message will still be there waiting for him, even if Alice had forgotten about it. Persistence means that conversations conducted through social media are far from ephemeral; they (C)[endure / vanish]. Persistence enables different kinds of interactions than the ephemerality of a park. Alice's message doesn't expire when Bob reads it, and Bob can keep that message for decades. What persistence also means, then, is that those using social media are often "on the record" to an unprecedented degree.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① sticks around - significant - endure: 콘텐츠가 '남아있고', 이것이 '중대한' 영향을 미치며, 대화가 '지속한다'는 원문.
❌ ② disappears - significant - endure: '사라진다'는 지속성과 반대.
❌ ③ sticks around - trivial - endure: '사소한'은 significant와 반대.
❌ ④ sticks around - significant - vanish: '사라지다'는 endure와 반대.
det.tip: stick around(남다) ↔ disappear(사라지다). significant(중대한) ↔ trivial(사소한). endure(지속) ↔ vanish(사라지다).

questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① persistence - asynchronous - unprecedented: 기술이 '지속성'을 가능하게 하고, '비동기적' 상호작용이 가능하며, '전례 없는' 정도로 기록된다는 원문.
❌ ④ deletion - asynchronous - unprecedented: '삭제'는 persistence와 반대.
❌ ② persistence - simultaneous - unprecedented: '동시적'은 비동기와 반대.
❌ ③ persistence - asynchronous - ordinary: '평범한'은 unprecedented와 반대.
det.tip: persistence(지속) ↔ deletion(삭제). asynchronous(비동기) ↔ simultaneous(동시). unprecedented(전례없는) ↔ ordinary(평범한).

✅ ③ far from - expire - keep: 대화가 일시적과 '거리가 멀고', 메시지가 읽어도 '만료되지 않으며', 수십 년간 '보관'할 수 있다는 원문.
